title: Grateful Dead Live at Texas Christian University on 1971-11-14

ai_review.summary: A crisp‑but‑not‑top‑tier capture of a late‑1971 transition show, highlighted by a soaring "Other One" and solid versions of Bertha, Sugaree and Wharf Rat.
ai_review.review: The performance sits at the crossroads of the early‑'71 primal energy and the emerging sophistication brought by Keith's piano. Reviewers rave about the deep, confident reading of The Other One and the delicate‑yet‑muscular Wharf Rat, while noting the recording is clear but falls short of a superior source when compared to other versions.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is rated high (strong set flow, standout jams) while recording quality is decent but not exceptional; weighted average yields a solid 4‑star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp and clear for the most part, though several reviewers note this version sounds inferior to an alternative tape and lacks the polish of a prime soundboard capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Typical early‑'71 format: short, punchy first‑set numbers followed by expansive second‑set jams; the transition feels smooth and confident.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Counts off and resets during "B.I.O.D.T.L."; delivers a deep, confident reading of The Other One.
band_member_comments.Phil: Still provides high harmonies and solid vocal support.
band_member_comments.Bob: Carries most rhythm duties as Keith begins to embellish on piano.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith Godchaux's piano adds sophistication but is not yet fully integrated; he embellishes rather than drives the rhythm.
